decisions.briefing:
I have taken a decision and I need the note that tells people about it.

The decision, 11 September, mine alone: data residency answers go out in writing, from me, inside a day. Frankfurt, no US subprocessor, my name on it. Decided against routing them through Legal first, because Legal added four days in June and did not change a single answer.

Who has to hear it, and why each one is awkward:
- Legal. They are being taken out of a loop they have been in all year, and the stated reason is their turnaround. That has to be said without reading as a complaint.
- Nadia and the deal desk. They need to know the path is now one day, so they can commit to it in front of a customer.
- Whoever answered the last residency question the old way, so they do not answer the next one that way.

Please read these before drafting, do not rely on my summary:
- the subprocessor list
- the Legal review thread from 3 June
- the Halden Mutual residency question sitting in my inbox

Then give me one short note to Legal and one line for the deal desk. Do not send either.

I have taken a decision, it is not clean, and I need the note drafted carefully.

The decision, 9 September, mine and Tomas’s: the migration goes in Q4, before the January freeze. It replaced the 28 August weekend, which came and went. Decided against slipping to Q1, which the room preferred and had picked twice.

The problem. It crosses a rule I set on 28 May with Elena, Head of Customer Success: no infrastructure change inside a renewal window. The room has picked November twice, and November is inside the renewal cycle for nine accounts. The 4 October weekend clears both. I call it at 11:00 today.

Who has to hear it:
- Tomas and the migration team, who are planning to November right now.
- Elena, whose rule this crosses. She should hear it from me and not from a plan document.
- The nine account owners, but only once the date is actually fixed.

Please read these before drafting, do not rely on my summary:
- migration plan v3 and #infra-migration
- the nine November renewals in the calendar
- Elena’s renewal windows doc from 28 May

Then give me the note that goes out if the date becomes 4 October, and the note that goes out if I grant the renewal rule an exception instead. Do not send either.
